evidence.quote: You will be billed at least for a minimum of 2 OCUs (1 OCU [0.5 x 2] indexing includes primary and standby, and 1 OCU [0.5 x 2] search includes one replica for HA) for the first collection in an account.
With Amazon OpenSearch Serverless Classic collections, you only pay for the resources consumed by the workload.
However, the minimum varies based on your data size and collections type in use.

claim: For Amazon OpenSearch Serverless Classic collections, you are billed at least for a minimum of 2 OCUs (1 OCU indexing including primary and standby, and 1 OCU search including one replica for HA) for the first collection in an account; the minimum varies based on your data size and collections type in use.

qualifiers.scope: OpenSearch Serverless Classic collections, first collection in an account
